title: Kalshi Microstructure Lab — machine-readable research ledger
note: Distilled from docs/RESEARCH_LEDGER.md. One row per research leg: hypothesis, where it reproduces, the key statistic, the verdict. verdict is the normalized filter category; status_raw is the exact ledger status. Every row cites its ledger leg via source_doc + ledger_leg.

verdict_legend.NEGATIVE: Tested honestly; no edge after costs at the data resolution we have.
verdict_legend.OPEN: Promising or unresolved; the blocking input is named.
verdict_legend.INFRA: Measurement/safety capability, not an edge claim.
verdict_legend.RESOLVED: Question answered/characterized (hygiene fix, execution-cost, or characterized-but-not-bankable).

legs.title: Polymarket BTC 5m Up/Down pipeline (original project)
legs.key_stat: pipeline worked; venue parked pre-evidence
legs.result: Full record/label/feature pipeline worked; discovery bug found+fixed; parked for account/funding reasons before model evidence.

legs.title: Kalshi KXBTC15M collection + OFFICIAL labeling
legs.key_stat: 770 gate windows, ~240k books, ~700k underlying rows
legs.result: Both train (150) and backtest (60) gates passed; healthy pipeline.

legs.title: A book+microstructure model beats the Kalshi price (taker)
legs.key_stat: AUC 0.90 but window-ECE 0.020 (market) vs 0.031+ (models)
legs.result: Fitted baselines are worse-calibrated than the price and LOSE after fees at the ask; market-implied trades 0 by construction.

legs.title: Isotonic calibration makes the model tradable
legs.key_stat: June-3 isotonic overfit test ECE 0.040→0.076; fixed to 0.058→0.026
legs.result: Original isotonic overfit and created a bias-dominated 5–16c edge buffer; fixed 2026-06-10 by retrain+repromote on 770 windows.

legs.title: Confidence-aware edge policy (Wilson buffers, reservation prices)
legs.key_stat: 1/137 positive final edge in shadow
legs.result: Buffers are mathematically correct and bias-dominated; policy correctly blocks ~all candidates.

legs.title: Shadow "passes" indicate edge
legs.key_stat: fades 0/5; identity knife-catches down windows 14% win
legs.result: Pass rows are regime luck: wins track realized window direction, not a repeatable edge.

legs.title: Trade more / trade less (frequency frontier)
legs.key_stat: distinct windows > trade count
legs.result: Marginal trades stop adding value almost immediately; overtrading destroys.

legs.title: Kalshi quotes lag BTC moves (stale-quote v1 at ~4s data)
legs.key_stat: median lag 0c; 4s cadence too coarse
legs.result: NULL: detected "opportunities" lose; 4s cadence cannot even see the hypothesis.

legs.title: Sub-second measurement layer
legs.key_stat: Binance ~27ms, Coinbase ~120ms, Kalshi REST ~1.1s
legs.result: Works: sub-second underlying ticks; Kalshi REST book RTT-bound at ~1.1s.

legs.title: Stale-quote v2 on hi-res joins
legs.key_stat: win 0%; +250/500ms ~0% covered (REST-polled book)
legs.result: NEGATIVE at REST cadence; unblocked 2026-06-10 by live WS book (~410 upd/s) — re-run after WS data accumulates.

legs.title: Residual-over-market models (predict y − p_market)
legs.key_stat: walk-forward deltas + ICs flip sign; lightgbm +2.14 split has worst ECE 0.070
legs.result: No model stably beats the market OOS; the one positive split is the worst-calibrated (luck).

legs.title: Replace the overfit calibrator with a safer one
legs.key_stat: market-implied best calibrated (0.0199) but is the price
legs.result: Fresh isotonic ~ break-even; swap gate declined all candidates; superseded by full re-promotion 2026-06-10.

legs.title: Maker (passive) entries recover the spread+fee
legs.key_stat: maker saves ~1.8c/fill vs taker, but per-side EV flips sign with BTC direction
legs.result: Real fills (3.2M prints): execution-cost question answered; static side-picking is pure drift exposure. Favorite-band cells positive both bounds but drift-confounded.
legs.status_raw: PARTIAL — execution cost answered; side-selection needs a signal

legs.title: Both-sides quoting (one-shot, join-bid both legs)
legs.key_stat: −3.15c per quote; negative 10/10 days; naked single-fill legs ~−21c
legs.result: Decisively negative: 74.9% double fills lock +0.97c but naked single legs are catastrophic; static quoting cannot survive.

legs.title: Deep-favorite YES bias (the one surviving cell)
legs.where: maker study by-price; ADE maker mine + autopsy 2026-06-15
legs.key_stat: DSR 0.998, PBO 0.00, win 100%, t>6 OOS; +2.65c/fill vs −96c tail
legs.result: Rediscovered independently and PERSISTS on the sealed holdout — but is short-vol favorite-capture (~2–4c collected against a −96c single-loss tail). DSR is blind to the unrealized left tail. Not bankable.
legs.status_raw: RESOLVED-CHARACTERIZED: real & OOS-persistent but not tradeable

legs.title: Kalshi market-data WebSocket feasibility
legs.key_stat: ~410 book updates/s, median recv age 14ms
legs.result: Verified 2026-06-10 with configured creds; KALSHI_HIRES_BOOK_SOURCE=auto now active (WS preferred, REST fallback).

legs.title: Deribit vol/options as model features
legs.key_stat: ablation delta-Brier ~ −0.0001
legs.result: Joined point-in-time as optional features; no standalone edge shown.

legs.title: Smaller-cap 15m series less efficiently priced than BTC
legs.key_stat: all four live + parse identically
legs.result: Series live, underlying feeds wired per asset; spread/calibration comparison vs BTC accumulating.

legs.title: Historical trade tape closes the maker-fill question now
legs.key_stat: ~600–700k KXBTC15M prints/day (~17% of the tape), 0 errors/dupes
legs.result: Done: idempotent backfill; note the endpoint is global (client-side series filter).

legs.title: Sub-second WS data usable end-to-end
legs.key_stat: DOGE hires dataset TRAINING_READY (269,750 rows / 164 windows)
legs.result: Done 2026-06-14: one --feature-source {rest,hires} flag flows to every consumer; REST default unchanged; full suite green.

legs.title: Hires-cadence outcome model beats market after cost
legs.key_stat: market best-calibrated on all 5 (ECE 0.024–0.057); models worse OOS (ΔBrier +0.006…+0.047)
legs.result: Concluded-negative across all 5 series; after-cost divergence-taker negative on all 5. Not regime luck — 5 independent assets agree.

legs.title: Sub-second signals predict the next underlying move
legs.key_stat: BTC IC mom_1s +0.195 (p~0, n=1M); z_fair IC~0
legs.result: True but NOT tradeable here: predicts the 1–5s CEX move you can't trade via a 15m Kalshi binary; the bridge (reprice-lag) is net-negative.
legs.status_raw: INFRA — structure real, no Kalshi P&L bridge

legs.title: Reprice-lag survives with sub-second WS book
legs.key_stat: BTC win 24%, PF 0.99 (break-even); coverage +250/500ms 0%→~87%
legs.result: WS book unblocked the short horizons; still no_edge. BTC is the closest-to-break-even result in the whole project.
legs.status_raw: OPEN (watch) — re-run after ≥1wk pure WS-book data

legs.title: Deep-favorite 90–98c + high-|z| taker cell (as a TAKER)
legs.key_stat: 0.98+ band (n=450) taker loses the fee (t−3.0); favorite yes% ~47–51%
legs.result: Concluded-negative for taker: no directional tilt; the deep-favorite positive was MAKER spread-capture, not a taker mispricing.
legs.status_raw: CONCLUDED-NEGATIVE for taker; maker lens still open

legs.title: Adverse-selection-aware maker (cancel on sub-second momentum)
legs.key_stat: cancel-aware ≤ baseline ~−1.7c; adverse selection grows with earlier entry
legs.result: Concluded-negative: mom_1s does not identify which maker through-fills lose; momentum-cancel makes them worse. Lone positive corner is a multiple-comparison artifact.

legs.title: Alpha Discovery Engine (ADE) — leakage-safe multiple-testing search
legs.key_stat: self-check: rejects noise (DSR 0.512/PBO 0.58), accepts planted edge (DSR 1.000/PBO 0.00)
legs.result: DSR + PBO(CSCV) + parameter-plateau + cross-asset-replication gauntlet, combinatorial purged CV, hash-pinned sealed holdout, append-only trial registry. Exec-realism (exec-lag) done. First mine surfaced +1.37c/trade t=+5.55 and the gauntlet REJECTED it (DSR 0.127).
legs.status_raw: INFRA — engine live + exec-realistic; no edge blessed

legs.title: ADE other domains: cross-asset pooled + execution/maker
legs.key_stat: cross-asset pooled DSR 0.001; maker DSR 0.998/PBO 0.00 (deep-favorite)
legs.result: Both domains mined: cross-asset is a 5/5-positive-but-underpowered near-miss; maker candidate is the deep-favorite short-vol cell (leg 15). No tradeable edge.
legs.status_raw: INFRA — both domains mined, no tradeable edge

legs.title: Cross-horizon KXBTC15M vs KXBTCD implied-vol coherence
legs.key_stat: σ extraction works (σ_1h ~41% annualized); needs concurrent history
legs.result: Discovery done: KXBTCD is a liquid hourly ladder that reads a full implied terminal CDF; coherence verdict needs recorded KXBTCD history (accumulating).

legs.title: Cross-coin relative value (BTC leads alts) — first cross-sectional bet
legs.key_stat: BTC concurrent implied-prob predicts alt outcome IC +0.63, residual IC +0.28 (stab 0.80); DSR 0.024, PBO 0.59
legs.result: Real lead-lag — strongest residual IC any mine produced — but the gauntlet rejects (overfit); alt spreads 3–4x BTC's eat the thin residual.
legs.status_raw: CONCLUDED-NEGATIVE (untradeable); cross-coin IC is the watch item

legs.title: Strike-ladder internal arbitrage (live KXBTCD/alt ladders)
legs.key_stat: directional ≥K ladders tight at 1.0100 (=1c spread), monotonic
legs.result: No arb: clean, monotonic, consistent ladders; strike-type-aware scanner (caught a naive range-market false-flag).

legs.title: Settlement-TWAP final-60s mechanic
legs.key_stat: IC vs outcome 0.865 (TWAP) vs 0.864 (spot) — averaging adds zero info
legs.result: No edge: the frozen partial-average distance is the instantaneous spot distance; after-cost n=3 −33c.

legs.title: Regime-CONDITIONAL edge (does efficiency break in a regime?)
legs.key_stat: 21 regime cells, 3988 trials, every cell DSR 0.00 after global deflation
legs.result: No conditional edge: seductive pockets (tod=h00 +17.8c, spread=hi +15.1c) are multiple-comparison mirages. Market efficient ACROSS regimes.

legs.title: Cross-coin tradability GAP — how far from tradeable per alt?
legs.key_stat: KXETH15M +1.23c/trade after cost but t=+0.56, PBO 0.59; SOL −1.08c, DOGE −2.70c, XRP −3.77c
legs.result: Gap scales with spread; ETH is the one cell a coin-flip from real but fails the gauntlet. Accumulate ETH forward windows and re-test.
legs.status_raw: OPEN-WATCH — re-test ETH through gauntlet if +1.2c holds t>2

legs.title: Multi-feature COMBINATION beats the price after cost
legs.key_stat: best combo +0.60c t=+0.19 (~zero), window-Sharpe 0.007, DSR 0.182, PBO 0.53
legs.result: The capstone: the combination ~exactly reproduces the market price — direct proof the price sits at the information frontier of the ENTIRE feature library.

legs.title: Print-level microstructure (large-print/sweep/toxicity)
legs.key_stat: p_large_signed residual IC +0.063 (too small); best rule DSR 0.525
legs.result: No edge: whale signed-vol is real but an order of magnitude too small; order flow already priced.

legs.title: Cross-sectional reversion (fade alt deviation from BTC factor)
legs.key_stat: best rule overfit PBO 0.73, DSR 0.184
legs.result: No edge: deviation features don't surface in top residual IC; the opposite-structured cousin of lead-lag (#29) is also dead.

legs.title: Value of SPEED — does faster execution unlock reprice-lag?
legs.key_stat: sub-second covered (+250/500ms 89%); still −0.027c/contract PF 0.82; Kalshi follows BTC 58% of shocks, median lag 0.13c
legs.result: No (for taker): the quote is barely stale — edge ABSENT, not latency-gated. Faster than 250ms changes nothing. Maker-speed open but needs live infra.
legs.status_raw: CONCLUDED-NEGATIVE for taker; maker-speed open but needs live

legs.title: Round-trip MARKET-MAKING + value of cancel/requote SPEED
legs.key_stat: static −1.76c; 250ms −717c vs 4s −201c — faster is worse; every fill 0.6–0.9c adversely selected
legs.result: Not viable, and speed makes it worse: MM needs a fair-value edge to avoid toxic fills and the project proved there is none. Kalshi has no maker rebate.
legs.status_raw: CONCLUDED-NEGATIVE; closes the fast-maker thread on the merits
